summary: Mr. Arking discusses the observance of Purim in Halab and how it compares to cities of doubtful wall status from the days of Yeshua bin Nun. He examines historical sources including Mahzor Aram Soba, Shulhan Melakh, Ohel Moed Musar, and Derekh Eretz to trace the practices of the Mustarabin and Sephardim communities regarding the Megillah, reading the Torah, and saying al hanissim.
questions: On which dates was Purim observed in Halab?
How do cities with uncertain wall status from the days of Yeshua bin Nun observe Purim?
What were the differences in Purim practices between the Mustarabin and Sephardim communities in Halab?
